name: How quickly can I sell my home after a cash home buyer consultation?

mainEntity.name: How quickly can I sell my home after a cash home buyer consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: One of the primary advantages of selling to a cash home buyer is the speed of the transaction. After a consultation with Kelby Contreras and a subsequent cash offer, closings can often occur much faster than traditional sales, sometimes in as little as two to four weeks, depending on the specifics of the property and buyer. Unlike traditional sales, there are typically no lender appraisals or financing contingencies that can cause delays. This expedited timeline is a key practical trade-off for sellers who prioritize a quick closing over potentially maximizing their sale price through a conventional market listing in competitive markets like Miami-Dade or Broward County.
